title: Questions 168-171 refer to the following advertisement.
passage_1:
We Are Hiring a Lead Landscape Architect

With our current lead landscape architect retiring after 22 years with the firm, Rowan & Fell is seeking someone with deep experience and a high level of imagination to take over this position. – [1] –. Our prize-winning studio concentrates on large private gardens, giving our clients planting plans that turn their grounds into living retreats. – [2] –.

The ideal applicant will have a strong portfolio showing skill in ground shaping, planting design, and stone selection. – [3] –. You will be in charge of guiding projects from first sketch to final handover and may even be asked to give clients advice about outdoor lighting.

Besides design work, you will work side by side with the building crews assigned to each project. – [4] –. You will be required to bring together teams with different specialties and to act as the main point of contact between them and the client.
